changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ItemStepTransitionState') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransitionState]( [FromItemStepID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [VersionStepTransitionID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Passed] [bit] NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [df__workflow_itemsteptransitionstate_state] DEFAULT (1) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [FromItemStepID] ASC, [VersionStepTransitionID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_FromItemStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransitionState] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_FromItemStep] FOREIGN KEY([FromItemStepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[ItemStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransitionState] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_FromItemStep] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_VersionStepTransitionID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransitionState] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_VersionStepTransitionID] FOREIGN KEY([VersionStepTransitionID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[VersionStepTransition] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransitionState] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransitionState_VersionStepTransitionID] END
